concerns.text: The plan states the dataset will contain ≤ 10 k rows but provides no power analysis or sample‑size justification that this size is sufficient to reliably detect the target performance (R² ≥ 0.6, |r| ≥ 0.5). Without a statistical power calculation the risk of under‑powered modeling is unquantified.

The risk table acknowledges “Collinearity among descriptors” and notes VIF will be reported, yet the implementation plan does not describe any corrective action (e.g., feature pruning, regularization, or decorrelation) nor how VIF findings will influence model training or importance interpretation.

The held‑out test set is a 20 % random split from the same curated dataset. No external or temporally separated validation set is planned, which may lead to optimistic performance estimates if the source data contain hidden batch effects.

Permutation importance is said to use a “max‑statistic method across features (family‑wise error control)”, but the exact correction procedure (e.g., max‑t, Holm‑Bonferroni) is not specified, making it unclear whether the claimed α = 0.05 family‑wise error rate will be achieved.
